body:
## Context
Issue #634: While `#530` withheld ambient `ADLC_*` variables from `modelPlaneEnv`, `repoCmdEnv` in `packages/fleet/lib/live-deps.mjs` passes `io.env` directly into `repoCommandEnv`, which retains every `ADLC_*` variable unconditionally (`packages/fleet/lib/env-scrub.mjs` is a frozen rail of active tickets `T-01M0Z3FN7SAS4HAH7CS63YQ0DH` and `T-01M0Z3G8MATGSZ0ECB6FAE0R08`). Because repo-committed `fleet.gate` commands run under `repoCmdEnv` and their failing stdout/stderr is fenced into `deadEnds` for the next strike prompt on the network-capable model plane, a failing gate command can relay operator-local trust-root paths (`ADLC_QUARTERMASTER_REGISTRY`, `ADLC_TICKET_STORE`, `ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS`, `ADLC_SIGNED_RUNNER_POOL`, `ADLC_RUNNER_PATH`) into the worker prompt.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `packages/fleet/lib/live-deps.mjs` filters ambient `ADLC_*` variables against `REPO_COMMAND_AMBIENT_ADLC_VARS` (`ADLC_TICKET`, `ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT`) and `config.envPassthrough` before passing the source environment to `repoCommandEnv`, withholding operator-local `ADLC_*` trust-root paths and bypass flags from `init`/`build`/`test` repo-command executions.
- `packages/fleet/lib/gates.mjs` (`scrubAdlcEnvAssignments` / `runGateCommand`) scrubs `ADLC_[A-Z0-9_]*=<value>` assignments from gate command output as defense-in-depth before output can be fenced into `deadEnds`.
- `packages/fleet/README.md` documents that ambient operator-local `ADLC_*` variables are withheld from the repo-command plane as well as the model plane.
- `packages/fleet/test/live-deps.test.mjs` verifies that `gate` and `createWorktree` (`init`) withhold ambient `ADLC_*` trust-root vars while keeping `ADLC_TICKET` and `ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT` and scrubbing `ADLC_*=` lines from gate output.

## Verification
`node --test packages/fleet/test/live-deps.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/model-plane-sandbox.test.mjs`
title: fix(fleet): withhold ambient ADLC_* trust-root vars from repo-command plane and scrub ADLC_*= from gate output (#634)
